title: Kanda 4: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 4.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 4.

verses.original: यस्तिष्ठति चरति यश्च वञ्चति यो निलायं चरति यः प्रतङ्कम् । द्वौ संनिषद्य यन्मन्त्रयेते राजा तद्वेद वरुणस्तृतीयः ॥
verses.transliteration: yastiṣṭhati carati yaśca vañcati yo nilāyaṁ carati yaḥ prataṅkam | dvau saṁniṣadya yanmantrayete rājā tadveda varuṇastṛtīyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Whosoever stands, moves, or slips away, whosoever walks in secret or in public; whenever two sit together and converse in private, King Varuna knows it as the third!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The renowned hymn of divine omnipresence: the cosmic witness sees every hidden thought and private conversation.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: Whosoever stands, moves, or slips away, whosoever walks in secret or in public; whenever two sit together and converse in private, King Varuna knows it as the third!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: अथर्ववेद काण्ड 4: The renowned hymn of divine omnipresence: the cosmic witness sees every hidden thought and private conversation.
